name: Agent cap
author: Brett
description: A configurable cap on how many headless Claude sessions and builds run at once on the VPS (agent-slots@1, framework/cli/agent-slots.mjs). Extras wait in a queue (FIFO within boss / urgent / normal / low) and start by themselves when a slot frees and memory allows; finished sessions don't count and close by themselves (logs kept). Settings (hot-reloaded): max running agents, max heavy test/build steps at once, memory guard, close-after, priority rules; shown in Settings → Plugins → Agent cap and in the Breakroom (Agent swarm) settings. Slots used / cap in the activity banner's summary, the queue (position, waiting since, Move up, Cancel) on the Builds page, 'waiting for a desk' on swarm agents past the cap, and a systems-check item when the memory guard trips often or swap stays in use.
